title: New Looks for Nitro, New Looks for You. Get Yourself a Nitro-exclusive Profile Bundle!
summary: Between now and September 30th, 2025, new and existing Nitro members can claim a profile bundle matching Nitro's new look, including an Avatar Decoration, Profile Effect, and a Nameplate! Open this blog to see the details.
body:
Back in ancient times (circa 2017), Discord Nitro started out as a way to support us in our early days while getting some sweet perks in the process. It had just four perks at the start, but those perks immediately became the stuff you associate with Nitro: animated avatars, custom emoji anywhere, bigger file uploads, and a snazzy profile badge. 

Eight years later, Nitro’s first four features have expanded to nearly 20 in total! Now it’s got HD streaming to share your game with smoother frames, the power to use stickers and soundboard sounds anywhere, and the latest feature: Custom Themes, to help make Discord match whatever mood you’re going for on your setup. Nearly every corner of Discord gets better when you’ve got Nitro!

And now, Nitro’s growing even MORE thanks to a brand new look, featuring a spacey vibe and a dark two-tone color scheme. At times, it’s a true-to-Discord deep blurple. Other times, it sports a fresh and moody tint of teal. Nitro’s new look feels just as primo as your upgraded Discord experience. And Wumpus even gained a new jetpack! (They're very excited to take it for a spin.)

None of this would’ve been possible without the millions of Nitro members out there supporting us and helping keep Discord’s core messaging features available for everyone. We wanna take a moment to celebrate YOU, our Nitro members, for letting the world connect while playing games… and we think you’d look great matching our new Nitro look.
